note: NECO Agric round 2 (Round 18 lift): fresh crop and soil items (yam mounds, cowpea nodules, staking, alley cropping, mulching, humus horizon, alluvial soils, hygroscopic water, crumb structure), animal husbandry (calcium for shells, brooding heat, battery cage, doe/sow, Rhode Island Red and Leghorn, N'dama trypanotolerance), pests (ladybird vs aphids, tsetse-nagana, foot-and-mouth virus, coccidiosis protozoan, rodents, rotation breaking cycles), tools (knapsack sprayer, cultivator, mower, nozzle), economics and extension (gross margin, farm diary, demonstration plot, cooperatives, fixed assets), agroforestry and afforestation, hook-and-line fishing, propagation (Irish potato tubers, scion, sugarcane cuttings, layering). Scanned against NECO round 1, the WAEC twin and the JAMB Agric banks.
